newsitem.title: CHINA: Bayer sets up Shanghai pigment factory.
newsitem.headline: Bayer sets up Shanghai pigment factory.

text.p: Germany's Bayer AG has opened a $22 million joint venture factory in Shanghai to produce high-grade iron oxide pigments used in industrial coatings and paints, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The newspaper said Bayer has a 67 percent stake in the venture and the Shanghai Coating Company the remaining 33 percent.
The plant, which opened on Tuesday, is expected to produce 20,000 tons of high-grade iron oxide pigment annually with about 90 percent of it earmarked for export.
